notes: HYBRID INSTRUMENT: the cover (page 1) and the Summary Page (page 4) are the Cache County Clerk/Auditor 'Candidate Financial Disclosure' form (form_read=cache_cfd), but the two schedule pages are a DIFFERENT, older instrument -- page 2 is headed 'ITEMIZED CONTRIBUTION REPORT (Form "A")' and page 3 'ITEMIZED EXPENDITURE REPORT (Form "B")', each footed '(If additional space is needed, use blank paper and list information like the above format and file with this report)' and machine-paginated 'Page 2' / 'Page 3'. Those handwritten subtotals are what is recorded in schedule_totals, with their 'Subtotal' label preserved verbatim so the distinction from a true schedule TOTAL is not lost; nothing was summed or reconciled here. NAME SPELLING vs LEDGER: the page spells the candidate 'Jon-David Jorgensen' (hyphenated given name; surname ends -sen), in both the Name of Candidate box and the Affirmation line; the ledger records 'Jon David Jorgensen' (no hyphen) and the filename uses 'Jon_David_Jorgensen'. Same person, spelling differs only in the hyphen. Box D reads '$8,830.17' with the '3' retraced over what may have been another digit; the same figure is written cleanly in Box E and on the Form B subtotal, so confidence stays high. The 'Balance at Close' box carries the filer's own qualifier '(minus in-kind)' written after the figure -- retained verbatim, not stripped. The amendment question is UNMARKED (neither 'No' nor 'Yes' circled). Neither 'Logged' nor 'Transmitted' is marked.
